source.title: Moon 3D Models for Web, AR, and Animation — color map and height map

mesh.format: NASAMOON v1; little-endian; 48-byte header, Float32 XYZ, Uint32 triangle indices
mesh.weld: Bit-identical Float32 XYZ only, first occurrence retained. Original triangle order and winding retained. No topography generated, no simplification.

texture.extraction: Embedded JPEG copied byte-for-byte, no re-encoding
texture.uv: u = 0.5 + atan2(-z,x)/(2*pi); vTop = 0.5 - atan2(y,hypot(x,z))/pi. JPEG top row is north. Shader sampling must handle longitude wrap per fragment.

coordinates.longitude: Degrees east; prime meridian at texture center (NASA CGI Moon Kit https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/4720/)

evidence.method: Original TEXCOORD_0 interpreted as equirectangular u=(lon+180)/360, vTop=(90-lat)/180; compared against POSITION directions at every source vertex
evidence.caveat: Axis convention is verified, but the original deformed mesh/UVs do not coincide exactly with a mathematical sphere, especially near pinched poles. Derived direction UVs intentionally discard source seam duplication.

scale.positionUnits: Original NASA GLB unitless Float32 positions, unchanged
scale.normalizationMethod: Triangle-area-weighted mean of vertex radii over all original triangles; computed in Float64
scale.caveat: 1737.4 km is the nominal lunar reference radius, not a recovered metric calibration of this artistic GLB. Its relief amplitude is preserved as supplied; mesh radii must not be interpreted as scientific heights.

limitations: Visualization only. Scientific illumination, line-of-sight, terrain, contact, and landing computations must continue to use Horizons and local LOLA numerical terrain.
NASA documents pinched-pole mesh artifacts. Use local LOLA for ground rendering near a landing site, not this global mesh.
NASA CGI Moon Kit color maps are optimized for aesthetics rather than science; polar color includes lower-resolution LOLA albedo.
